messages.subject: Apologies for SPAM
parts:
Hello all,

Due to the recent flood of SPAM getting through the filters, all new member posts will be moderated. 

I would also like to apologise for my delay in responding to several recent posts. I am going through a very difficult family emergency and will not likely have time to respond any time soon. I would encourage other members of this community to respond if they have answers that can be provided. 

All the best,
Zhian
